rows.title: Reset-semantic substrate corruption as a convergent failure regime in repeated bounded self-improvement
rows.required_unit: A first-party AI4AI task×model×effort trajectory with frozen candidate-algorithm text and official normalized score; raw patch bytes are not required for this secondary semantic-edit audit.
rows.asset_audit: AI4AI first-party release exposes 290/290 trajectory pages and /ai4ai/data/points.json. All 290 detail pages were materialized and SHA-256 hashed; official normalized points reproduce 124/290 below 0.1 and the published 0.166 mean. Public release is redacted and does not expose raw diff bytes, so support is qualified only for the frozen secondary semantic-edit falsifier, not source-diff or repeated-round causal claims.
rows.support_scope: Secondary AI4AI public trajectory-level semantic-edit audit of reset/init/seed/checkpoint state-establishment changes versus official normalized below-0.1 outcomes. Does not qualify the primary repeated-round SPADE reset-only vs step-only intervention.

rows.title: Complex-description boundary in end-to-end 3D world construction
rows.required_unit: VWE-Bench per-case query metadata sufficient for matching plus first-party per-case Pass@1/model outcome and preferably stage-specific failure labels.
rows.asset_audit: Official VibeWorlding-Gym code was cloned at ddb6ff54d34a2483859960743319f5d5e5b33e96. README declares 6,828 VWE-Bench queries and 254 evaluation cases, but the GitHub checkout contains data placeholders; this run did not materialize the Hugging Face query corpus or first-party per-case model outcome table. Code release alone cannot instantiate the frozen matched boundary falsifier.
rows.reopen_only_if: First-party VWE-Bench query units and per-case model/evaluator outcomes can be materialized with content hashes so matching and stage-error analysis are independent of the candidate claim.

rows.title: Stateful-feedback validity horizon for self-evolving skill controllers
rows.required_unit: SkillEvo round-level units exposing the same initial single-turn feedback basis, later multi-turn defect classes, revision schedule, TSR/defect outcomes, and a reproducible controller or first-party code/data sufficient to construct matched within-basis versus outside-basis units.
rows.asset_audit: As of 2026-08-24, source review found the SkillEvo paper and aggregate results over 9 production Skills and 98 skill-reference files but no verified maintained first-party repository or released unit-level dataset sufficient for the frozen matched horizon falsifier. Aggregate TSR curves cannot establish feedback-basis mismatch.
rows.reopen_only_if: A first-party SkillEvo repository/dataset or provenance-equivalent unit-level release exposes feedback/revision trajectories needed for matched inside-basis versus outside-basis analysis.
